tasks.name: Perimeter Patrol With Return 2
tasks.content: Send Volt on a perimeter patrol at 26.2 meters: start at corner A (182.8, 141.2), continue to corner B (824, 191.5), corner C (867.8, 543.3) and corner D (122.7, 564.7), then return home and land. The patrol is only complete when the drone is back on the ground at its home position. Fly the waypoints in the order listed and pass within 12 m of every one of them before returning home; do not cut the loop short.

tasks.name: Grid Survey Coverage Sweep 4
tasks.content: Have Watt take off to 23.1 meters, then fly a rectangular survey grid over the south-west corner (194.4, 422.3), the south-east corner (661.6, 485.3), the north-east corner (791.3, 177.7) and back to the south-west corner, staying at 23.1 meters the whole time. Take a photo as it reaches every waypoint, including the return over the south-west corner, so four photographs in total, and finish hovering above that last waypoint. Fly the waypoints in the order listed and pass within 12 m of every one of them before returning home; do not cut the loop short.
